job.style: a diary entry or letter by a student

response.passage: October 14th. Today, I visited the bustling Sunday Farmer’s Market at Green Valley with my grandmother, Mrs. Sharma. The market was incredibly crowded because the local harvest festival attracted hundreds of visitors from nearby villages. I saw 45 stalls lined up, each overflowing with fresh produce. Mrs. Sharma was looking for organic turmeric, which she insists is the secret to her immunity. We walked past a man named Mr. Gupta, who was selling hand-woven baskets, but we didn't stop because we were in a hurry to reach the vegetable section. The heat was intense, and by noon, the crowd had thinned out significantly. I bought 12 kilograms of potatoes for our monthly supply. It was fascinating to see how the market functions as a social hub rather than just a place to trade goods. My grandmother explained that the market remains open until sunset, but the best deals are found early in the morning. I felt exhausted by the time we left, yet I learned so much about our local food systems. It was a day well spent, and I hope to return next month with my friend Rohan to explore more.
response.summary: A student describes a visit to the Green Valley Farmer's Market with their grandmother. They observe the crowd, the variety of goods, and the social importance of the market. The visit concludes with the student reflecting on the experience and planning a future trip.
